[quote=camphill;58590754]Why do you have a limit anyway?[/quote]
A large part of NationStates is having the ability to raid and take over other regions. Raiders do this through getting the highest amount of endorsements in a region, thus giving them WA powers which they can use to destroy the region. As such, regions have to take measures to ensure they don't get destroyed.

One of these measures is implementing endorsement limits. It prevents members of a region from getting any ideas of couping the region or helping out raiders and taking control in an illegal manner.

[nation]syaftyn[/nation]
If you want to go ahead with moving regions, feel free to do so. People are always allowed to come and go as they like. However, I hope you understand why we are asking you to reduce your endorsement count. We aren't trying to insult you or get you to insult others, it's simply something that all regions do for security reasons.
